description.value: Twin Peaks Resort is a guest house located in Valemount, British Columbia, a small mountain community in the Robson Valley region. Valemount sits at the junction of several major cycling routes and serves as a gateway to Mount Robson Provincial Park, making it a natural overnight stop for touring cyclists. The resort's location on Jack Adams Road places it within the town, convenient to local services.
